additions_since_v2.stale_action_identity_bridge: If an action's recorded ISIN is not active on the event date, use that ISIN's nearest symbol-history segment as a bridge, then resolve the symbol/ISIN actually active on the event date.
additions_since_v2.structural_mapping_guard: Merger/demerger may map only to a trading row within 30 calendar days before or after the effective date; otherwise it remains unmapped rather than attaching to a distant future row.
additions_since_v2.audit_identity: Explicit structural exposure audit matches selected rows against resolved point-in-time ISIN first, then resolved symbol.

existing_rules_unchanged.split_bonus: price and share-volume normalization; turnover unchanged
existing_rules_unchanged.merger_demerger: structural reset/censor, no synthetic multiplicative price factor
